note: The Village Studio's change layers, per town: read on sharp pictures and Sentinel-2 by the village damage reports and kept in the Studio. A feature is a change seen on the ground, never a count of incidents, and towns are never added together.

labels.title: Building destroyed
labels.description: A mapped building read as destroyed on a sharp before and after pair, by a majority of independent readers or by a person.

labels.title: Building damaged
labels.description: A mapped building read as damaged on a sharp before and after pair, by a majority of independent readers or by a person.

labels.title: Building changed (Sentinel-2)
labels.description: Rubble or cleared ground at a mapped building, seen as a lasting brightening on Sentinel-2. A 10 m pixel is about one house, so it says the ground at the building changed, not which house.

labels.title: Building ruined before the 2026 war
labels.description: A building already a ruin on the last sharp picture before the 2026 war, read so by a majority of independent readers or by a person. It is counted in the state on the newest pictures and in the earlier count, never in the 2026 count. Its dating is before the 2026 war, never a day of the 2026 war.

labels.title: Road cratered or blocked
labels.description: A stretch of a pre-war road read as cratered or blocked on a sharp before and after pair, by a majority of independent readers or by a person.

labels.title: Road bulldozed before the 2026 war
labels.description: A stretch of a pre-war road already bulldozed on the last sharp picture before the 2026 war, read so by a majority of independent readers or by a person. It is counted in the state on the newest pictures and in the earlier count, never in the 2026 count. Its dating is before the 2026 war, never a day of the 2026 war.

labels.title: Airstrike crater
labels.description: A round pit or blast scar in forest, orchards, fields or open ground, more than 5 m from any building or road mapped before the war, read so by at least three independent readers who are the majority of those who could judge, or by a person, and dated from October 2025 on: the last sharp picture before it is from October 2025 or later, or it is new between two 2026 pictures, or Sentinel-2 first saw its ground change then. The label names the cause on the data owner's decision of 2026-10-27. The readers judged a pit on the pictures, which do not show what made it. Counted by number, as a point at its centre with its outline kept beside it, never added to buildings, roads or land.

labels.title: Airstrike crater, no closer date
labels.title_ar: حُفر غارات جوية، دون تاريخ أدقّ
labels.description: A round pit or blast scar in forest, orchards, fields or open ground, more than 5 m from any building or road mapped before the war, read so by at least three independent readers who are the majority of those who could judge, or by a person, that appeared between the last sharp picture before the 2026 war and a 2026 picture, with nothing to date it closer: the interval can hold the end of the first war, or both wars. It is never in the 2026 count. The label names the cause on the data owner's decision of 2026-10-27. The readers judged a pit on the pictures, which do not show what made it. Counted by number, as a point at its centre with its outline kept beside it, never added to buildings, roads or land.

labels.title: Airstrike crater before the 2026 war
labels.description: A round pit or blast scar in forest, orchards, fields or open ground, more than 5 m from any building or road mapped before the war, read so by at least three independent readers who are the majority of those who could judge, or by a person, already on the last sharp picture before the 2026 war, a wartime picture of the first war, and not on the pre-war picture: made in the first war. It is counted in the earlier count, never in the 2026 count. Its dating is before the 2026 war, never a day of the 2026 war. The label names the cause on the data owner's decision of 2026-10-27. The readers judged a pit on the pictures, which do not show what made it. Counted by number, as a point at its centre with its outline kept beside it, never added to buildings, roads or land.

labels.title: Counting area
labels.description: The area the village's damage report counts in: the village and the ground within 1.5 km of its built-up area.
